# 未來星宿劫千佛名經

**ID:** T0448a
**Volume:** T14
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 闕譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0448a

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Wèilái xīngxiù jié qiān fómíng jīng* enumerates the thousand Buddhas of the future aeon, the "Starry Aeon" (*xīngxiù jié* 星宿劫), completing the "three aeons, three thousand Buddhas" (*sān jié sānqiān fó*) system alongside the past-aeon ([KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0023)) and present-aeon ([KR6i0024](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0024)–[KR6i0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0025)) texts. Two recensions are preserved in the Taishō: T448a (this text) and T448b ([KR6i0027](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0027)). The text is anonymous; the "a" recension is supported by major canon editions.

**Abstract**

T448a is the principal Taishō recension of the future-aeon thousand-Buddha-names list. The "Starry Aeon" (*xīngxiù jié* 星宿劫) is a Chinese Buddhist cosmological concept for the aeon following the present bhadrakalpa, in which a thousand more Buddhas will appear; the name suggests an aeon characterized by stars (*xīngxiù* 星宿, "lunar lodges / asterisms"). The three-aeon structure completes a devotional calendar that encompasses all of Buddhist time. This text completes the group; see [KR6i0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0022)–[KR6i0025](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0025) for the past- and present-aeon parallels.
